slots.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

slots.title: RedotPay weighs confidential US IPO filing by year-end: Bloomberg
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: The stablecoin payments company previously disputed reports that its US listing had been delayed.

slots.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.

slots.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.

slots.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine favors share buybacks to ether purchases as crypto declines
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Ethereum treasury firm spent $46 million buying back shares as Chairman Tom Lee said crypto has held up better than AI stocks during the recent market pullback.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Keystone initially disclosed a leak of customer information but has since disclosed that hackers also stole a key that could allow counterfeit wallets to pass authenticity checks.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
